Container.Name: mcp-memory
Container.Overview: Persistent AI memory service with semantic search. SQLite-vec backend, HTTP/SSE transport. Tailscale sidecar variant -- no published ports, accessible via Tailscale overlay network. REQUIRES a sidecar named exactly tailscale-mcpmemory deployed first.
Container.Requires: **CRITICAL: A Tailscale sidecar container named EXACTLY `tailscale-mcpmemory` must be deployed BEFORE this template will start.** Deploy the generic tailscale-sidecar template first, but rename the container from the default `tailscale-sidecar` to `tailscale-mcpmemory` and rename the state path from `/mnt/user/appdata/tailscale-sidecar/` to `/mnt/user/appdata/tailscale-mcpmemory/`. This container shares the sidecar's network namespace via `--network=container:tailscale-mcpmemory`. See docs/TAILSCALE_SIDECAR_GUIDE.md for the full pattern.
Container.Description:
Deploys doobidoo/mcp-memory-service with SQLite-vec backend, sharing the network namespace of a Tailscale sidecar container. No ports are published to the host. The service is reachable only via the Tailscale overlay network at the sidecar's Tailscale IP on port 8000.
============================================================ REQUIRED RENAME BEFORE DEPLOYMENT ============================================================ The tailscale-sidecar template ships with default container name `tailscale-sidecar`. This mcp-memory template references `Container:tailscale-mcpmemory`. You MUST rename the sidecar container (and its state path) to `tailscale-mcpmemory` before deploying this template, OR edit the Network field of this template to match the actual name of your sidecar.
If you skip this step, Docker will report "container tailscale-mcpmemory not found" and the container will fail to start. ============================================================
Generate an API key before starting: openssl rand -base64 48
Reach the WebUI/dashboard at http://<sidecar-tailscale-ip>:8000 from any device on your tailnet. Find the IP in the Tailscale admin console under the hostname you set as TS_HOSTNAME on the sidecar.
First boot downloads a ~90MB ONNX embedding model -- can appear to hang for several minutes. Watch the container log for progress.
Healthcheck queries localhost:8000/api/health every 30 seconds. localhost works because this container shares the sidecar's network namespace.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: SQLite-vec database directory. Contains memory.db and WAL files.

Config.Name: Backup Directory
Config.Description: Nightly SQLite dump output. Point host-level backup tools here.

Config.Name: MCP API Key
Config.Description: Bearer token for all requests. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 48

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID. Default 99 (nobody) is correct for Unraid.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID. Default 100 (users) is correct for Unraid.

Config.Name: HTTP Enabled
Config.Description: Enable HTTP server. Must be true.

Config.Name: HTTP Port (internal)
Config.Description: Internal listening port. Accessible via Tailscale sidecar IP.

Config.Name: SQLite Path
Config.Description: Path to SQLite database inside container.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Log verbosity. INFO for normal, DEBUG for troubleshooting.
